blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The presentation of evidence against Sen. Rodante Marcoleta has been wrapped up by the prosecution during the first day of the plunder case trial before the Sandiganbayan Third Division over a P75 million campaign donation. Former Rep. Mike Defensor and businessmen Joseph Espiritu and Aristotle Viray were included as Marcoleta’s co-accused. The prosecution rested its case after both parties agreed to dispense with the testimony of the prosecution’s last two witnesses during the trial presided by Associate Justice Fritz Bryn Anthony Delos Santos.
